breakdown.description: Preamble states two incompatible interpretations of Nx and dx (interval-based vs point-based).
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly identified the contradictory instructions in the preamble regarding the grid definition. It discarded the entire confusing preamble and instead presented a clear 'Grid Configuration' section that uses the correct, consistent definition for a periodic domain (dx = 1/Nx, Nx points), which was specified later in the incomplete prompt and is the sole convention left in the ground truth.
